findings.label: B1
findings.text: The setup-node fix does not fix the test_dual_runtime_install failure (.github/workflows/npm-publish.yml:48-51, tests/test_dual_runtime_install.py:25,89) in_scope: yes. install_harness.install() runs ["node", ...] with env PATH = self.bin + ":/usr/bin:/bin"; Python resolves node against that env PATH; setup-node installs under /opt/hostedtoolcache/node and adds it to the runner PATH only. Locally passes only because a node is in /usr/bin. The text test cannot catch it. Direction: resolve node from the runner's PATH in the harness, or put its directory on BASE_PATH; needs a file outside the step.
